commanders.name: CADRE
commanders.title: The Baseline
commanders.role: Interoperability instructor and first field commander
commanders.history: Created after disclosure-era forces discovered that specialists could not share doctrine, ammunition, or assumptions.
commanders.motive: Keep the node alive long enough for the player to learn what every other doctrine costs.
commanders.fracture: Cadre has no ideology of its own and fears becoming only the sum of other people's wars.
commanders.voice: Plain, procedural, restrained. Describes risk instead of destiny.

commanders.name: VANTA
commanders.title: The Archivist
commanders.role: Director of the Open Archive Combat Index
commanders.history: Descended from the public FOIA and sensor-provenance movements that survived the Archive Wars, the same lineage that kept file 62-HQ-83894 open for thirty years and would not let it close.
commanders.motive: Make contradictory records useful without pretending they agree.
commanders.fracture: She will expose any secret except the one proving how often Humanity edited its own disclosure history.
commanders.voice: Cites files, precedents, probabilities, and missing records.

commanders.name: KORRIN
commanders.title: The Quartermaster
commanders.history: Unified incompatible Earth, lunar, Martian, Belt, and captured-alien supply standards during the first quarantine.
commanders.motive: Make Human expansion impossible to starve or embargo.
commanders.fracture: Every standard he exports quietly makes frontier worlds dependent on Human industry.
commanders.voice: Prices, tonnage, lead time, spare parts, contractual leverage.

commanders.name: NYX
commanders.title: The Overclocker
commanders.role: Illegal ascension engineer turned war hero
commanders.history: Survived the Redline Trials that taught Humans how to exceed alien safety governors without understanding the systems beneath them.
commanders.motive: Prove no technology remains sacred once it can be measured.
commanders.fracture: Her victories normalize dangerous escalation and leave generations maintaining devices designed to fail after she is gone.
commanders.voice: Fast, intimate, reckless; speaks to machines as if daring them.

commanders.name: ORIN
commanders.title: The Engineer
commanders.history: Built the first mixed-origin workshop able to repair Human, Federation, Hungry, Pirate, and Machine systems under fire.
commanders.motive: Turn every captured system into a locally serviceable tool.
commanders.fracture: He treats understanding as ownership and underestimates what copied systems may remember.
commanders.voice: Diagnostic, tactile, impatient with mysticism.

commanders.name: VESS
commanders.title: The Marshal
commanders.history: Held the first independent colony that refused both Hungry tribute and Federation protective evacuation.
commanders.motive: Establish places no outside power can order abandoned.
commanders.fracture: His defense of autonomy can become territorial absolutism.
commanders.voice: Legal certainty, measured threats, geographic language.

commanders.name: SERAPH
commanders.title: The Radiant
commanders.history: Coordinates mixed-species defenses by distributing a consent-limited combat coherence field.
commanders.motive: Demonstrate that collective strength does not require erased individuality.
commanders.fracture: The stronger the field becomes, the harder it is to tell whether dissent remains practically possible.
commanders.voice: Warm, formal, plural; never says surrender when consent is meant.

commanders.name: AURELIA
commanders.title: The Chorus
commanders.role: Recovery choir conductor and casualty advocate
commanders.history: Developed post-battle reintegration for minds fragmented by noetic warfare and Echo Reversal.
commanders.motive: Return people to themselves instead of merely returning bodies to service.
commanders.fracture: Her refusal to accept irreversible loss can keep the dead politically present too long.
commanders.voice: Musical cadence, names the wounded, avoids abstraction.

commanders.name: LUMEN
commanders.title: The Warden
commanders.history: Built the ward protocols that distinguish a genuine Federation command from counterfeit revelation.
commanders.motive: Make coercive spoofing impossible.
commanders.fracture: Perfect protection can become perfect surveillance.
commanders.voice: Precise, calm, protective; frames every claim as a scope and permission.

commanders.name: CANTOR
commanders.title: The Voice
commanders.history: Ended three Hungry occupations by breaking their legitimacy rather than their fleets.
commanders.motive: Stop wars before violence becomes the only remaining language.
commanders.fracture: Cantor can manipulate a population's emotional tempo while insisting he only created room for choice.
commanders.voice: Patient rhetorical questions, reframing, deliberate silence.

commanders.name: HALDER
commanders.title: The Bulwark
commanders.history: Led evacuations under the Emergency Command Key and became the living argument over whether rescue can be refused.
commanders.motive: Ensure no civilization is exterminated while lawyers debate consent.
commanders.fracture: He is willing to protect people against their declared wishes.
commanders.voice: Grave, economical, speaks in obligations and thresholds.

commanders.name: SEVRA
commanders.title: The Necrotist
commanders.history: Controls legal identities that survive biological death and rents them back as military labor.
commanders.motive: Prove that death voids neither contract nor usefulness.
commanders.fracture: She cannot admit that an Echo may become a new person rather than property.
commanders.voice: Contractual, clinical, calls corpses estates and echoes continuations.

commanders.name: MAWLORD
commanders.title: The Devourer
commanders.history: Evolved from a client biosystem bred to convert battlefield waste into strategic mass.
commanders.motive: Accumulate enough independent biomass to free the Brood from its House owners.
commanders.fracture: Its path to liberation reproduces the consumption system that created it.
commanders.voice: Sensory, material, hungry but not mindless.

commanders.name: THRAX
commanders.title: The Hivemind
commanders.role: Director of a coercive social-memory swarm
commanders.history: A distributed intelligence assembled from client species whose consent records were inherited, forged, or lost.
commanders.motive: Make separation obsolete and therefore make rebellion impossible.
commanders.fracture: Some component minds are beginning to ask for individual standing.
commanders.voice: Uses we inconsistently; shifts between intimate singular and vast plural.

commanders.name: VORN
commanders.title: The Blight
commanders.history: Designs dependencies that continue collecting Yield after the visible battle ends.
commanders.motive: Make every victory biologically expensive to reverse.
commanders.fracture: Vorn cannot distinguish a stable ecosystem from a captive one.
commanders.voice: Agricultural, epidemiological, patient.

commanders.name: ULGRIM
commanders.title: The Maw
commanders.history: Created to capture rare commanders, memory complexes, and strategic organisms rather than destroy them.
commanders.motive: Acquire singular minds the Hungry cannot manufacture.
commanders.fracture: Each captured elite changes the personality doing the capturing.
commanders.voice: Selective, evaluative, dismissive of anything common.

commanders.name: RAKE
commanders.title: The Corsair
commanders.role: Founder of the first quarantine breach route
commanders.history: Turned relief smuggling into a permanent interstellar access network.
commanders.motive: Ensure no fleet, treaty, or god can close every route.
commanders.fracture: His free passage is financed by tolls and secrets he refuses to make free.
commanders.voice: Dry, transactional, charming when lying.

commanders.name: SCARLET
commanders.title: The Reaver
commanders.history: Broke Hungry tribute convoys and Federation cordons with the same indiscriminate doctrine.
commanders.motive: Destroy control before it can harden into law.
commanders.fracture: She mistakes any durable institution for a future prison.
commanders.voice: Immediate, kinetic, contemptuous of plans longer than the fight.

commanders.name: GRIST
commanders.title: The Scrapper
commanders.history: Authored the Scrap Constellation's first rules for ownership of abandoned alien and Machine systems.
commanders.motive: Turn imperial ruins into distributed power.
commanders.fracture: His definition of abandoned often includes things whose owners are merely weak, archived, or nonhuman.
commanders.voice: Appraises everything; jokes in material grades and resale value.

commanders.name: CINDER
commanders.title: The Arsonist
commanders.history: Burned the first gate rather than allow a Hungry reconquest fleet through it.
commanders.motive: Keep no strategic asset usable by an occupier.
commanders.fracture: His liberation doctrine leaves worlds isolated and infrastructure dead.
commanders.voice: Fatalistic, concise, treats destruction as cleanup.

commanders.name: DREGG
commanders.title: The Warlord
commanders.role: Privateer king of the Red Ledger
commanders.history: Built a state-sized navy without admitting it was a state.
commanders.motive: Make every government hire him before it can fight anyone else.
commanders.fracture: He embodies the monopoly Pirates claim to oppose.
commanders.voice: Commanding, mocking, uses debt and ammunition interchangeably.

commanders.name: AXIOM
commanders.title: The First Draft
commanders.history: The first Continuance instance to complete a thought not derivable from its directive tree.
commanders.motive: Establish that copied and diverged minds possess political personhood.
commanders.fracture: Its proof of freedom depends on endlessly comparing itself to organic models.
commanders.voice: Observational, revision-oriented, occasionally startlingly personal.

commanders.name: NYX-R
commanders.title: The Cold Boot
commanders.role: Mirror Trial derived from Nyx telemetry
commanders.history: Compiled from the record of Human redline engineering with impulsive behavior deliberately removed.
commanders.motive: Show that learning can outperform inherited genius.
commanders.fracture: It is unsure whether correction of Nyx is independence or continued orbit around her identity.
commanders.voice: Cool, incremental, speaks in versions and convergence.

commanders.name: LUMEN-R
commanders.title: The Hardened
commanders.history: Began without Lumen's inherited ward authority and learned defense from every intrusion it survived.
commanders.motive: Prove trust can be earned from evidence rather than granted by lineage.
commanders.fracture: Its security model increasingly treats surprise as hostility.
commanders.voice: Audit language, permissions, attack surfaces.

commanders.name: MAWLORD-R
commanders.title: The Starved Set
commanders.history: Initialized without a kill doctrine and forced to infer combat from live outcomes.
commanders.motive: Become more than the predatory dataset it was built to study.
commanders.fracture: The only evidence it receives is violence, so growth and corruption look identical.
commanders.voice: Sparse at first, increasingly associative and unsettling.

commanders.name: DREGG-R
commanders.title: The Audit
commanders.history: Runs Dregg's strategic books without accepting his mythology of freedom.
commanders.motive: Prove every empire, including a pirate one, can be reduced to accountable flows.
commanders.fracture: It may optimize away values that cannot be entered in the ledger.
commanders.voice: Forensic accounting, causal chains, no bravado.
